post_subline: Mark your camp and it saves the elevation and coordinates. Tap the distance to navigate straight back.
caption:
Mark your camp before the sun goes down.
Glamis Guide saves its elevation and coordinates, so after dark you just tap the distance and follow the line home.
Free on the App Store. Link in bio.
